description.value: Oxford Ice Cream is a small-batch artisan ice cream shop in Langley run by two engineering-trained owners who craft rotating seasonal flavors from scratch. The shop offers a mix of dairy and vegan options, with gluten-friendly choices clearly marked on the menu. It's a distinctive stop for cyclists along Fraser Highway looking for a quality sweet treat beyond standard chain offerings.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: stands (2 spaces) at 54m; bollard (2 spaces) at 99m. Total: 4 spaces.
